stem:
Anvi lists every whole number from $20$ to $29$. She wants how many times the digit $2$ is written in that list.

Which two claims are both correct?

options.text: The digit $2$ appears $10$ times, once for each number in the list.
In the tens place, $2$ appears in every number from $20$ to $29$, so that is $10$ writings.
In the ones place, $2$ appears once more in $22$, so the total is $11$ writings of the digit $2$.
Counting only the ones digits from $20$ to $29$ already gives the full answer $10$.

teacher.key_rationale: Tens digit 2 appears 10 times; ones digit 2 appears once in 22; total 11. A treats each number as one digit-2. D counts only ones digits and stops at 10.
